title: Recurring anti-COVID-measures and vaccine-mandate protests: pre-month context
notes: ORF reported large Vienna and multi-capital demonstrations on 11–12 Dec 2021; its 7 Jan preview anticipated the Jan 8 Vienna and Jan 9 Innsbruck protests, and Reuters/Euronews described the Jan 15 Vienna Saturday event as routine. This documents an active sequence and context, not a verified continuous campaign episode, common organization or onset date. No January event is backdated; prior owner/onset remains unresolved.

title: Bregenz anti-mandate demonstrations continued after January
notes: S009 reports that further anti-mandate demonstrations were planned after the 22 Jan Bregenz rally. S022 documents a 26 Feb Bregenz rally, approx. 1,300, using a familiar route with vaccine-mandate abolition still the main demand. This establishes later activity but not whether the January and February actions share a coded episode or when the recurring series ended.
